mimus_check_graph

Module cache 

Source
Expand description

Per-file triples cache — ADR-0002 phase 3. extract_triples is pure over claims, but claims derive from source files — so the cache sits one level up: per source file, keyed on (path, content hash, TRIPLES_VERSION). Same bytes + same extractor version → sqlite rows instead of re-extraction; an edit changes the hash → the file’s rows are rewritten.

sqlite at .mimus/triples.db — repo-local, same open pattern as the kuda index readers. A files marker row is the key so a file yielding zero triples still caches (the marker hits, the triples table simply has no rows for it).

Structs§

TriplesCache
sqlite-backed store — one Connection, opened (creating) by the caller, so the same cache serves a whole check run.

Constants§

TRIPLES_VERSION
Extractor version — bump on any mimus-claims::triples change. Rows written by an older version just miss; they are never wrong.

Functions§

extract_triples_cached
Claims → triples through the cache. Claims group by source — each file hashes its bytes once: hit → stored rows, miss → extract that file’s claims and rewrite its rows. First-seen file order is preserved so output stays deterministic.
triples_cache_rows
Row count for mimus doctor — None when the db is missing or unreadable. Read-only open: doctor never creates the file.
